This beta is not signed with an Apple Developer ID yet, so macOS quarantines the download and your
DAW may call Cosmati "damaged" or say it "can't be verified". After copying the plugins (step 1),
clear the quarantine once, in Terminal (Applications > Utilities > Terminal):

  xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/CLAP/Cosmati.clap
  xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/Cosmati.vst3
  xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/Cosmati.component
  xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Cosmati.app

(the last one where you put Cosmati.app). Then restart your DAW and rescan.

Signing takes these steps away, and costs about USD 99 a year with Apple. If you'd like to help get
Cosmati signed: https://ko-fi.com/Rastapopolix
